description: Main source file for Bluetooth TMAP central role implementation, including connection management, scanning, security, and service discovery.

methods.name: att_mtu_updated
methods.description: Callback invoked when the ATT MTU is updated, signals the semaphore for MTU exchange completion.

methods.name: tmap_discovery_complete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of TMAP service discovery, signals the discovery done semaphore.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth, registers GATT callbacks, and enables Bluetooth functionality.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth connection event, signals connection semaphore, and manages connection address.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth disconnection event, signals disconnection semaphore, and cleans up connection.

methods.name: security_changed
methods.description: Handles security level change events, signals security update semaphore.

methods.name: check_audio_support_and_connect
methods.description: Parses advertising data to identify TMAS support and initiates connection if supported.

methods.name: scan_recv
methods.description: Callback for received scan data, filters for connectable devices supporting TMAS.

methods.name: scan_and_connect
methods.description: Performs scanning, waits for connection, MTU exchange, and security setup.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing Bluetooth, services, scanning, and performing Bluetooth operations.
